# Pinned external sources

These are ordinary files in the wafer_simulator repository, not submodules.
Do not edit author source in place. Put integration code in src/wafer_sim and
reviewed native changes in patches/, applied to isolated remote build worktrees.

See ../docs/EXTERNAL_SOURCES.md and ../configs/upstream_repositories.json for
origin, exact revisions and purpose. manifests/ retains file hashes and original
Git objects needed to restore exact runtime source checkouts offline. Optional
nested upstream gitlinks are recorded but not used by this project.
